test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 3rd December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

Conceal : Reveal :: Expand : ?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• Conceal : Reveal → Conceal is antonym of Reveal.

Similarly,

 
• Expand : ? → Expand is antonym of Shrink.

Hence, '**Shrink**' is the correct answer.
